views.name: students_active
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  student_id,
  current_address_id,
  permanent_address_id,
  first_name,
  middle_name,
  last_name,
  cell_mobile_number,
  email_address,
  ssn,
  date_first_registered,
  date_left,
  other_student_details
FROM Students
WHERE date_left IS NULL
views.description: One row per student who is currently active (has not left). Use this to restrict analyses to current students/cohorts. | Use for: List current students and their contact info; Join current students to enrollments/transcripts; Count active students by address or program

views.name: student_addresses
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.student_id,
  s.current_address_id,
  s.permanent_address_id,
  s.first_name,
  s.middle_name,
  s.last_name,
  s.cell_mobile_number,
  s.email_address,
  s.ssn,
  s.date_first_registered,
  s.date_left,
  s.other_student_details,
  curr.address_id AS current_address_address_id,
  curr.line_1 AS current_address_line_1,
  curr.line_2 AS current_address_line_2,
  curr.line_3 AS current_address_line_3,
  curr.city AS current_address_city,
  curr.zip_postcode AS current_address_zip_postcode,
  curr.state_province_county AS current_address_state_province_county,
  curr.country AS current_address_country,
  curr.other_address_details AS current_address_other_address_details,
  perm.address_id AS permanent_address_address_id,
  perm.line_1 AS permanent_address_line_1,
  perm.line_2 AS permanent_address_line_2,
  perm.line_3 AS permanent_address_line_3,
  perm.city AS permanent_address_city,
  perm.zip_postcode AS permanent_address_zip_postcode,
  perm.state_province_county AS permanent_address_state_province_county,
  perm.country AS permanent_address_country,
  perm.other_address_details AS permanent_address_other_address_details
FROM Students s
LEFT JOIN Addresses curr ON s.current_address_id = curr.address_id
LEFT JOIN Addresses perm ON s.permanent_address_id = perm.address_id
views.description: Denormalized student row with both current and permanent address details. Useful when you need student contact/address fields alongside student attributes. | Use for: Map students to address cities/zip for demographic reports; Mailing lists using current vs permanent address; Join students with enrollments while also pulling address fields

views.name: enrolments_with_semester_program_student
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  se.student_enrolment_id,
  se.degree_program_id,
  se.semester_id,
  se.student_id,
  se.other_details AS other_enrolment_details,
  sem.semester_name,
  sem.semester_description AS semester_description,
  sem.other_details AS semester_other_details,
  dp.degree_program_id AS degree_program_degree_program_id,
  dp.department_id AS degree_program_department_id,
  dp.degree_summary_name AS degree_program_degree_summary_name,
  dp.degree_summary_description AS degree_program_degree_summary_description,
  dp.other_details AS degree_program_other_details
FROM Student_Enrolment se
LEFT JOIN Semesters sem ON se.semester_id = sem.semester_id
LEFT JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id
views.description: One row per Student_Enrolment enriched with semester, degree program and student identifiers/attributes. Use to analyze enrollments by semester or program or to join to course-level enrollment rows. | Use for: Count enrollments by semester or program; Join enrollments to student_course assignments or transcripts; List students enrolled in a program for a semester

views.name: student_enrolment_courses_wide
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sec.student_course_id,
  sec.course_id,
  sec.student_enrolment_id,
  se.student_id,
  se.semester_id,
  se.degree_program_id,
  c.course_name,
  c.course_description,
  c.other_details AS course_other_details
FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses sec
LEFT JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON sec.student_enrolment_id = se.student_enrolment_id
LEFT JOIN Courses c ON sec.course_id = c.course_id
views.description: One row per Student_Enrolment_Courses enriched with enrolment-level (semester/program/student) and course details. Useful for course-level counting, grade joins, and per-course student lists. | Use for: List students in a course in a given semester; Aggregate course enrollments by semester or program; Join to transcripts/transcript contents to get grades per course instance

views.name: department_program_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.department_id,
  d.department_name,
  COUNT(dp.degree_program_id) AS program_count
FROM Departments d
LEFT JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON d.department_id = dp.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_id, d.department_name
views.description: Aggregated count of degree programs per department. One row per department with program_count. Useful for department-level inventory and joins to departmental analyses. | Use for: How many programs are in each department?; Join department-level program counts to enrollment summaries

views.name: enrolment_counts_by_semester_program
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  se.semester_id,
  se.degree_program_id,
  COUNT(se.student_enrolment_id) AS enrolment_count
FROM Student_Enrolment se
GROUP BY se.semester_id, se.degree_program_id
views.description: Counts of student_enrolment rows by semester and degree program. One row per (semester_id, degree_program_id) with enrolment_count. Useful for trend and capacity analysis. | Use for: Enrollment counts by term and program; Compare program enrollment across semesters

views.name: course_enrollment_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sec.course_id,
  COUNT(sec.student_course_id) AS student_count
FROM Student_Enrolment_Courses sec
GROUP BY sec.course_id
views.description: Counts of Student_Enrolment_Courses rows per course (and optionally per semester via join). One row per course_id with student_count. Useful for course popularity metrics. | Use for: Which courses have the highest enrollment?; Join counts to course metadata for catalogs

views.name: students_latest_enrolment
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  se.student_enrolment_id,
  se.student_id,
  se.semester_id,
  se.degree_program_id,
  se.other_details AS other_enrolment_details
FROM (
  SELECT
    se.*, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY se.student_id ORDER BY se.semester_id DESC, se.student_enrolment_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM Student_Enrolment se
) se
WHERE se.rn = 1
views.description: Latest enrolment per student determined by semester_id ordering (assumes semester_id encodes order). One row per student with their most recent student_enrolment_id. Useful for current-program or latest-term queries. | Use for: Find each student's most recent enrolment/program; Join students to their latest semester for reporting

views.name: student_course_counts_by_student
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  se.student_id,
  COUNT(sec.student_course_id) AS course_count
FROM Student_Enrolment se
JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses sec ON se.student_enrolment_id = sec.student_enrolment_id
GROUP BY se.student_id
views.description: Number of course enrollments per student across all enrolment periods. One row per student_id with course_count. Useful to measure student course load historically. | Use for: Total courses taken per student; Filter students by course load thresholds

views.name: courses_catalog
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  course_id,
  course_name,
  course_description,
  other_details
FROM Courses
views.description: Canonical course projection exposing core descriptive columns for catalogs and joins. Use when you need a normalized course row with predictable column names. | Use for: Join course metadata to enrollment counts or transcripts; Produce course listings

views.name: degree_programs_with_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  dp.degree_program_id,
  dp.department_id,
  dp.degree_summary_name,
  dp.degree_summary_description,
  dp.other_details AS degree_program_other_details,
  d.department_name,
  d.department_description AS department_description,
  d.other_details AS department_other_details
FROM Degree_Programs dp
LEFT JOIN Departments d ON dp.department_id = d.department_id
views.description: Degree_Programs joined to Departments, one row per degree_program_id with department attributes. Useful to categorize programs by department. | Use for: List programs with their department labels; Aggregate enrollments by department via programs
